newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-A.C. Moore files for 2.7mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-A.C. Moore files for 2.7mln shrs.

text.p: A.C. Moore Arts & Crafts Inc filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an initial public offering of up to 2.7 million shares it expects to sell between $12 and $14 each.
Underwriters for the offering, Alex Brown & Sons Inc and Janney Montgomery Scott, have an over-allotment option of up to 405,000 shares.
The Blackwood, N.J., operator of arts and crafts superstores said proceeds from the sale will be used to repay outstanding debt, finance new store openings and for other working capital needs.
After the offering, the company will have seven million common shares outstanding.
